notes: Verified Bellissimo Geni records supplied by the kennel. Family relationships are resolved automatically from supplied sire/dam references across dog and young-dog records. Branco Custodi Nos, Anthie Custodi Nos, and Karma Custodi Nos ancestry is transcribed from the supplied KSS export pedigrees through four generations. Repeated ancestors are shared records rather than duplicates. Missing facts remain blank or Not recorded. Current-dog ownership is published where supplied; microchip numbers and other private records are not published. New Litter B pedigree ancestry (Sforza Neron × Sforza Sara) is also transcribed; newly introduced records are stored as drafts so they remain admin-only until explicitly published.

dogs.name: Branco Custodi Nos
dogs.bio: Branco Custodi Nos is part of the Bellissimo Geni Cane Corso family. His verified pedigree connects through Dragoslav Custodi Nos and Himera Custodi Nos.

dogs.name: Karma Custodi Nos
